session_note: FL's 2026 regular session convened 2026-01-13 and adjourned sine die 2026-03-13 (Florida's constitutional 60-day regular session; multiple bills' final floor/committee actions cluster on that date); bills passed then go through engrossment/enrollment and presentation to the Governor, who has a limited number of days to sign, veto, or allow a bill to become law without signature.
